lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid with the highest intensity maxima concentrated in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low density of small, faint, high-luminance spots is visible on the anterior portion of the dorsal fin; the posterior region is largely silhouetted and lacks clear internal patterning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, bright white horizontal linear mark is present on the mid-posterior section of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high-density cluster of small, uniform spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those located on the lateral flank.
